critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1221 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into separate route files (auth_routes.py, workspace_routes.py, receipt_routes.py) for maintainability
Receipt processing uses 2 Claude API calls per scan (parse_receipt_with_claude + match_items_with_claude). Consider combining into single prompt to reduce latency and cost

MINOR: testID prop on React Native FlatList items renders as data-testid in DOM, but Playwright tests should use [data-testid=...] not [testID=...] for reliability (confirmed data-testid works for currency-btn-*, household-settings-* selectors)
MINOR: expo-image-picker package version mismatch warning (55.0.10 vs expected ~17.0.10) - this may affect image picker behavior on some platforms
